name: Rally-X explosion sound
drawing: Logic Bd I schematic A082-91385-C000, Rally-X Parts and Operating Manual (doc 1cc6c9614736, PDF p. 39) -- via MAME's netlist, compared with it and corrected
revision: Rally-X Logic Board I, explosion ('BANG') circuit: CD4006/CD4070 noise gated by a CD4066, a uA741 stage at 12E and an MB3730 bridge amplifier at 12A.
coverage: 5 ICs, 29 other parts and 30 nets over 109 pins. Converted from MAME's netlist and corrected from the sheet: the explosion circuit and the power amplifier, with the Namco WSG's audio arriving as a port. The rest of the board's sound is a MAME device, not a netlist. The board view carries the ICs and the nets between them, with the board's grid positions on a nominal spacing.

origin.sourceLabel: The conversion, every change from MAME's file logged
origin.what: The netlist is MAME's -- written to simulate this board, from its schematics -- converted here into the board's own nets, with MAME's simulation stand-ins undone and, where this site holds the schematic, checked and corrected against it. The board view, chip lookup and bill of materials are made from it.
